purpose: Teach: 配給/ジャーナリズム/公衆/リアルタイム/真っ赤/隠す/断念/上る

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦時の、本気で、絶対、配給、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, you handled wartime distribution systems with real depth in your paper. I was genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Warm, measured praise. Slight pause before naming the topic—careful attention. Steady eye contact. Voice carries genuine recognition without flattery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。戦後の、本気で、絶対、ジャーナリズム、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to explore how journalism evolved in the postwar period—it felt important to examine that shift closely.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Slight nervousness at the start, settling into conviction as she speaks. Earnest without performing earnestness. Grateful and present.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦前の、本気で、絶対、公衆、絶対、衛生、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And your treatment of prewar public health initiatives—that showed real intellectual range. You saw connections others might have missed.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly surprised by her own observation. Leans in slightly. Warm recognition that's specific enough to land as genuine. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。報道の、本気で、絶対、リアルタイム、絶対、化、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: I tried to show how news cycles shaped public response in real time. It felt like the missing piece.
lines.style: Quiet confidence building through the sentence. Not defensive—collaborative. Speaking as someone who actually understands the work. Clear and direct.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時の、本気で、絶対、真っ赤、絶対、な、絶対、夕焼け、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you contextualized wartime imagery—those details about propaganda and shadow—that was the mark of serious thinking.
lines.style: Reflective, almost studying her as she speaks. Slower pace. Genuine surprise at the depth. Not flattering—observing something real. Slight warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。歴史を、本気で、絶対、隠す、絶対、行為、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to show how history gets buried, how what we don't talk about shapes us as much as what we do.
lines.style: Vulnerable but steady. She's saying something that matters to her. Slight tremor of honesty beneath the surface. Measured, not rushed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時の、本気で、絶対、断念、絶対、された、絶対、計画、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And your examination of abandoned wartime projects—the plans that never came to be—that was insightful framing.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause at the opening. Appreciative, recognizing the difficulty of that kind of research. Voice carries weight and substance. Genuine intellectual respect.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。歴史で、本気で、絶対、犠牲者数が、絶対、上る、絶対、事象、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to understand how the numbers—how those human losses—are woven into historical analysis. It felt necessary to hold that weight.
lines.style: Grounded, serious. This is the heart of what she cares about. Not performed emotion, but genuine and clear. Quiet strength. Ending with a sense of completion.
